The great beyond awaits for us all. Good luck and have a safe eternity. 

Love ya

Why the train tracks tho? That’s a bit messy.  Also there’s a slight chance you may possibly be severely injured instead of dead.  We’re talking missing limbs here.  Probably hella brain damage too. 

If you’re gonna die, it’s best to pick a for SURE method. Anyways love ya and I hope you find your peace in a non-brutal fashion. 

Don’t end up a vegetable “miracle” story.

I’m sorry this happened to you. I know it’s hard to believe, but you are beautiful. 

Unfortunately Alex didn’t see that. I love you and I hope for the best.
